name: pcb-builder
description: World-Class Autonomous PCB Builder with AI-powered design assistance

scripts.dev:backend: docker compose up -d && cd backend && make dev
scripts.dev:desktop: concurrently "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev -w pcb-builder-desktop"
scripts.desktop: concurrently "npm run dev:frontend" "npm run dev -w pcb-builder-desktop"
scripts.build:desktop: npm run build:frontend && npm run build -w pcb-builder-desktop
scripts.lint: concurrently "cd backend && ruff check ." "cd frontend/apps/web && npm run lint"
